title: 纟 silk (绞丝旁)
intro: 纟 is the simplified left-side form of 糸 (silk thread), written in three strokes. Characters with 纟 are about thread, tying, lines, paper, and colors (silk was dyed). Many abstract words come from "tying": 结 (tie, end), 约 (bind, arrange), 终 (end of a thread).

ex.zh: 春节的时候长辈会给孩子红包。
ex.p: chūn jié de shí hou zhǎng bèi huì gěi hái zi hóng bāo
ex.en: At Spring Festival, elders give children red envelopes.

ex.p: hóng dēng tíng lǜ dēng xíng
ex.en: Red light stop, green light go.

ex.p: wǒ xǐ huan hē lǜ chá
ex.en: I like drinking green tea.

ex.p: hóng dēng tíng lǜ dēng xíng
ex.en: Red light stop, green light go.

ex.p: wǒ mèi mei shǎng sān nián jí
ex.en: My younger sister is in third grade.

ex.zh: 春节的时候长辈会给孩子红包。
ex.p: chūn jié de shí hou zhǎng bèi huì gěi hái zi hóng bāo
ex.en: At Spring Festival, elders give children red envelopes.

ex.p: gěi wǒ ba
ex.en: Give it to me.

ex.p: zhè shì wǒ sòng gěi nǐ de lǐ wù
ex.en: This is a gift I'm giving you.

ex.zh: 我已经等了半个小时了。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ jīng děng le bàn gè xiǎo shí le
ex.en: I've already waited half an hour.

ex.zh: 我经常跟朋友练习说汉语。
ex.p: wǒ jīng cháng gēn péng you liàn xí shuō hàn yǔ
ex.en: I often practice speaking Chinese with friends.

ex.p: huì yì shén me shí hou jié shù
ex.en: When does the meeting end?

ex.p: kǎo shì jiē guǒ chū lái le ma
ex.en: Are the exam results out?

ex.zh: 我经常跟朋友练习说汉语。
ex.p: wǒ jīng cháng gēn péng you liàn xí shuō hàn yǔ
ex.en: I often practice speaking Chinese with friends.

ex.p: wǒ měi tiān liàn xí xiě hàn zì
ex.en: I practice writing characters every day.

ex.p: nǐ kàn le jīn tiān de bào zhǐ ma
ex.en: Have you read today's newspaper?

ex.p: qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ
ex.en: Please give me a sheet of paper.

ex.zh: 这条路线的交通很方便。
ex.p: zhè tiáo lù xiàn de jiāo tōng hěn fāng biàn
ex.en: Getting around on this route is very convenient.

ex.p: wǒ men xiàn shǎng jiàn ba
ex.en: Let's meet online.

ex.zh: 我们约好了明天下午见面。
ex.p: wǒ men yāo hǎo le míng tiān xià wǔ jiàn miàn
ex.en: We arranged to meet tomorrow afternoon.

ex.zh: 从这儿到机场大约要一个小时。
ex.p: cóng zhèr dào jī chǎng dà yuē yào yī gè xiǎo shí
ex.en: It takes about an hour from here to the airport.

ex.zh: 你仔细看看，这两个字有什么不一样？
ex.p: nǐ zǐ xì kàn kàn zhè liǎng gè zì yǒu shén me bù yī yàng
ex.en: Look carefully, how are these two characters different?

ex.p: qǐng zǐ xì kàn
ex.en: Please look carefully.

ex.p: tā zhōng yú zhǎo dào le gōng zuò
ex.en: He finally found a job.

texts.title: 读一读 · 纟 silk (绞丝旁)

lines.zh: 春节的时候，爷爷奶奶给了我一个大红包。
lines.p: chūn jié de shí hou yé ye nǎi nai gěi le wǒ yī gè dà hóng bāo

lines.zh: 我很高兴，因为我已经等了一年了！
lines.p: wǒ hěn gāo xìng yīn wèi wǒ yǐ jīng děng le yī nián le

lines.zh: 我用红包里的钱买了一本练习本和很多彩色的纸。
lines.p: wǒ yòng hóng bāo lǐ de qián mǎi le yī běn liàn xí běn hé hěn duō cǎi sè de zhǐ

lines.zh: 妹妹上三年级，她喜欢画画，我给了她一半的纸。
lines.p: mèi mei shǎng sān nián jí tā xǐ huan huà huà wǒ gěi le tā yī bàn de zhǐ
tā shuō xiè xie gē ge
